purpose: Teach: ルピー/一室/座敷/刺す/ザル/ローテーション/そりゃあ/ちまう

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、世界のお金の、絶対、ルピー、絶対、図鑑で見たよ
lines.en: Mom, I saw it in a book — they use rupees, real money, in the whole world!
lines.style: Breathless discovery. Words tumble out with absolute conviction. Bright eyes, leaning forward. The earnest urgency of a child sharing something he's certain is important.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お家の、本気で、絶対、一室、絶対、お父さんの、絶対、書斎、絶対、なのよ、翔くん
lines.en: That book is in Dad's study at home, sweetheart. He keeps it there.
lines.style: Gentle redirect, not dismissive. Warm acknowledgment of his discovery while gently orienting him. Steady voice, the tone of someone who knows where things belong.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、お祖父ちゃんちの、絶対、座敷、絶対、ぼく、絶対、好きなんだ
lines.en: But Mom, I really love the tatami room at Grandpa's house. It's so nice there.
lines.style: Softer now, more introspective. He's moved to something that matters to him more personally. Quiet sincerity. The words come slower, more thoughtfully.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、お裁縫で、絶対、指を、絶対、刺す、絶対、ように、絶対、気をつけてね
lines.en: Just be careful with the sewing needle, okay? You don't want to prick your finger.
lines.style: Gentle but attentive warning. Not alarmed, but present — the kind of care that comes from noticing what he's about to do. Steady, protective tone.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、お昼ご飯、絶対、ザル、絶対、お蕎麦、絶対、いいな
lines.en: Mom, can we have cold soba noodles for lunch? That would be so good.
lines.style: A small, hopeful request. Lighter mood — he's thinking about something he wants. Quiet enthusiasm, not demanding. The brightness of a simple preference.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お父さんの、本気で、絶対、勤務、絶対、ローテーション、絶対、今月、絶対、忙しいのよ、翔くん
lines.en: Your dad's been working those rotating shifts this month, and it's been keeping him quite busy.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact observation, slightly weary but not complaining. She's stating a fact he should understand. Grounded, practical tone — the quiet reality of household rhythms.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: そりゃあ、本気で、絶対、ぼくも、絶対、お父さんの応援、絶対、するよ、ママ
lines.en: Of course I'll cheer Dad on too, Mom. I want to help.
lines.style: Solemn little promise. He's stepped into something bigger — trying to be responsible. Slower pace, deeper sincerity. The voice of a child who's decided something matters.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、おやつ、絶対、全部、絶対、食べちまう、絶対、と、絶対、お夕飯に、絶対、響くわよ
lines.en: But if you eat all your snacks now, you won't have room for dinner later, sweetheart.
lines.style: Tender warning wrapped in affection. Close, intimate — the tone you use when you're sitting near someone you love and want to look out for them. Knowing, not scolding.
